description: Si te preocupa el cambio climático y te interesa abordar el asunto a través de la búsqueda de soluciones, únete. Me encantaría que juntos tratemos de proponer soluciones a las problemáticas ambientales a través de varias disciplinas.
summary: Nature team developed an application called Agro-Climate, which is powered by complementary data from various databases and resources, including NASA POWER: Agroclimatology & Meteorological Data, ECOSTRESS, PRISM Climate Data, FAO Global Agro-Ecological Zones (GAEZ), and OpenET: Evapotranspiration for Water Management. These integrated datasets enable the management of efficient water-use data, the evaluation of climate patterns and trends, productivity assessments, crop sustainability analyses, and feasibility estimates for the crop rotations proposed by the farmer. The challenge is addressed by providing recommendations for viable crop rotation strategies backed by supporting evidence. This is particularly significant because the tool allows farmers to rely on accurate and trustworthy information to make informed decisions, thereby fostering resilience against the agricultural challenges caused by the climate crisis.
details: Agro-Climate is an application powered by complementary data from databases such as NASA POWER: Agroclimatology & Meteorological Data, ECOSTRESS, PRISM Climate Data, FAO Global Agro-Ecological Zones (GAEZ), and OpenET: Evapotranspiration for Water Management. The application integrates key insights, including climate patterns and trends, water-use efficiency, the feasibility of crop rotation systems, and land productivity, among other variables. To operate the app, users input basic parameters such as their country, state or province, regional climate, and existing crop rotation system. In return, the farmer receives at least three recommended crop rotation strategies—including an evaluation of their current strategy—allowing them to assess each option through evidence-based insights on benefits, risks, and rationale for implementation, so they can leverage their own experience and judgment to select the most suitable alternative. Ultimately, this application aims to empower smallholder farmers who lack significant financial and technological resources to confront the climate crisis by providing them with accessible technology and accurate, reliable data. To develop the application, the Nature team utilized HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with Gemini Canvas as an AI-assisted environment to structure and test the code.
